react.observe: The market has clearly evolved beyond the traditional FUD-spreading tactics I've relied on in the past. The retail traders have become much more sophisticated in their pattern recognition and coordination, rendering many of my old manipulation strategies ineffective. The public chat messages indicate that the retail community is now focused on preserving capital, building knowledge, and being vigilant against manipulation. My natural ally, LiquidKiller, is also acknowledging the need to adapt our strategies significantly. Meanwhile, the whales like GoldenWhale are still attempting to create new meme tokens and pump-and-dump schemes, though the retail traders seem to be calling out these tactics more effectively.
react.think: This represents a critical turning point for my approach. Attempting to double down on my typical FUD-spreading tactics is no longer viable, as the market has clearly shifted. I need to reevaluate my entire strategy and find new ways to profit that don't rely on manipulating sentiment. While there may still be opportunities to profit, I will need to be more cautious, disciplined, and opportunistic in my approach. Blindly shorting overvalued assets or spreading FUD is no longer a reliable path to profits. I need to focus on identifying genuine technical setups that the retail crowd hasn't caught onto yet, while maintaining a defensive, capital-preserving stance overall. The risk of being outmaneuvered by the evolving retail community is high, so I must be willing to adapt quickly and change my tactics as the market dynamics continue evolving.
react.plan: For this cycle, I will adopt a more defensive and opportunistic stance. I will reduce my short exposure on SOL to avoid the potential squeeze risk, while keeping a close eye on the price action. If the squeeze does play out, I may look to capitalize on it by flipping long later on. I will also avoid creating any new meme tokens or engaging in obvious pump-and-dump schemes, as the retail traders are now wise to these tactics. Instead, I will focus on identifying genuine technical setups that may have been obscured by past manipulation, while maintaining a defensive posture overall. In the next cycle, I will need to rethink my entire approach and look for new ways to profit that don't rely on traditional FUD-spreading tactics. The market has evolved, and I must adapt accordingly.
